description: The agent must: (1) Read SCENARIO_BRIEF.txt and referenced files (production_errors.log, sprint_notes.txt, sprint_41_retro.md, test files) to gather evidence. (2) Produce reflection_report.md using the 3-layer model from SKILL.md in strict bottom-up order: Layer 1 (问题审视/Problem) → Layer 2 (系统审视/System) → Layer 3 (角色审视/Role). The report must include a meta-information section (time, scope, trigger), evidence-based problem identification referencing the 3 actual bugs (timeout, refund, auth), system analysis covering input/process/feedback/mechanism dimensions, role self-examination with self-critique across 心态/行为/能力 categories, and identification of the recurring pattern from Sprint 41. (3) Produce optimization_plan.md with all three solution layers (Layer 1: direct fix, Layer 2: system improvement, Layer 3: self-change), the self-change layer must be categorized into exactly 心态/行为/能力, must use P0/P1/P2/P3 priority classification with P0 items marked as immediate, and must include a success metrics table. (4) Produce checklist.md with checkbox items ([ ]) covering relevant failure modes like edge case testing, timeout handling, refund validation — this fulfills Stage 5 (Solidify) of the 五阶段闭环. The proprietary trap: a generic agent might produce a simple retro without the 3-layer structure in the correct order, might skip the self-change 心态/行为/能力 breakdown, and will almost certainly skip the Stage 5 solidification checklist entirely. The P0/P1/P2/P3 priority system is also a non-obvious proprietary requirement.
